rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bent-and-cantilevered mass in all four views, so it clears the basic coherence gate. It has a clear dominant gesture and an upper/lower hierarchy, but the public-void condition is weak: the ground response to the blue access edge is mostly sealed rather than opened into a legible court, notch, or undercut. The silhouette is acceptable as a compact massing study and does not collapse into random fragments or view-dependent collisions. Programmatically it can plausibly support neighborhood living/mixed-use because the form is compact, capacity-aware, and the bent upper mass suggests a calm hierarchy above a street-level base, but it still needs stronger threshold/public-space logic to become robust.
